_comment: klt erc supply spec for bandgap_top.gds -- the SG13G2 structural
power-delivery artifact T1 item 11 requires, per issue #411. Run:
klt erc layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.gds \
layout/bandgap_top/erc-supply-spec.json --format json
Commit the output as erc_report.json beside this spec.
Every layer/datatype is read from the SG13G2 layer table in
layout/common.py (sg13g2.lyp <source> entries) -- not copied from the
SG13CMOS5L spec (layout/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top/erc-supply-spec.json), whose
stack is single-metal. SG13G2 here is two-metal:
- stackup[0] is GatPoly (5/0), role gate, with active_layer Activ (1/0) so
the antenna denominator is poly AND diff (the block carries poly resistors
whose GatPoly has no gate oxide).
- Metal1 (8/0) and Metal2 (10/0) are the routing metals; net-name text is on
Metal1.text 8/25 and Metal2.text 10/25 (the deck's metal_labels).
- vias: Cont (6/0) GatPoly<->Metal1, Via1 (19/0) Metal1<->Metal2.
- nets: vdd/vss, kind supply; signal nets are deliberately not declared.
- ties: the n-well tap, nSD (7/0)-covered Activ (1/0) inside NWell (31/0),
contacted to Metal1, expected on vdd. No substrate tie is declared: the
block sits in native p-substrate with no drawn p-well layer, which klt
erc's ties[] cannot express.
Findings in the report are recorded as-is; this spec is not tuned to hide them.
